domains.domain_definition: Urban mobility and smart city planning organise how people and transport move around cities. Transport planners and engineers design road, rail and airport projects, while land planners and smart city consultants apply urban planning and environmental policy to make cities work better. Government agencies, engineering firms and construction companies carry out this work.
domains.industry_context: Urban transport planning; mass transit design; smart traffic systems; mobility-as-a-service; electric vehicle charging infrastructure; congestion management. Nigeria: Lagos BRT; Abuja metro; LAMATA; state transport authorities. African Development Bank Urban Mobility Programme. Lagos congestion costs estimated at $8bn/year — creating massive investment demand.

domains.domain_definition: Autonomous vehicle engineering develops cars and other vehicles that can drive themselves.
